uncertainties.detail: The source is unvocalized and omits the hamza that would distinguish first-person أحتجب from imperative احتجب in fully specified spelling. An imperative is morphologically possible in isolation. My finding is contextual: after 'you say', this is the reciter's protection formula, continuing into first-person 'I have protected all'; first-person self-protection is the coherent reading. Do not claim the canonical source explicitly contains a first-person hamza, and do not alter the Arabic. If this ambiguity is retained rather than contextually resolved, flag it locally instead of silently choosing the second-person command.

The 'and because you, if you wish, follow ...' connection is genuinely awkward in the supplied canonical text. Both targets preserve its content and carry an appropriately language-specific uncertainty marker; no further rework requested for that passage.
Missing vowels do not establish unique vocalizations of the opaque names. Audit verifies token/consonant coverage and numeral positions, not unattested vocalization or efficacy.

findings.source_location: ocr/enriched/page_082.txt:29, read with the first-person closing fragment at lines 33-34
findings.source_excerpt: تقول احتجب بعزة الله تعالى العزيز ... حفظت جميع
findings.english_excerpt: Say: Take shelter behind the might of God Most High
findings.indonesian_excerpt: Ucapkanlah: Berlindunglah di balik keperkasaan Allah Yang Mahatinggi
findings.problem: The outer instruction is 'say', but the words spoken are contextually the reciter's self-protective declaration. Both targets make the inner formula another command to a second person, changing its speaking actor and protective voice. The source spelling is underdetermined in isolation; that uncertainty does not warrant treating the current imperative as an unquestionable reading.
findings.required_rework: Retain the outer 'Say' / 'Ucapkanlah' instruction but use first-person self-protection inside the formula, e.g. 'I take shelter ...' / 'Aku berlindung ...', leaving opaque tokens, all numerals, quotations, and canonical Arabic untouched. Alternatively, explicitly mark the genuinely unresolved first-person/imperative ambiguity in each target rather than silently fixing the inner voice to second person. Revalidate and obtain a fresh independent review after any content change.
